d-sorg-fleet-bulk.purpose: Default HDD-tier label for lightweight audits, governance workflows, docs checks, and read-mostly maintenance.

d-sorg-fleet-docker.purpose: Container-build label for Docker image builds, Trivy scans, and jobs that churn layered caches.

d-sorg-fleet-fast-io.purpose: Capability label for workflows that need high local I/O without being Docker-specific.

d-sorg-fleet-nvme.purpose: Physical NVMe-tier label for the fastest pool when jobs need explicit placement.

bulk.description: Lightweight maintenance, governance, and read-mostly workflows should stay on the bulk tier once the dual-pool host is live.

docker.description: Docker image builds and container security scans should avoid the HDD bulk tier.

fast-io.description: High-churn test/build workflows should prefer a fast-I/O or NVMe-capable label once tiered pools are available.
